data.narrative:
Stoke Space is a Series D-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $860M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 5 public equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, including Apex Space, Varda Space Industries, and others operating in adjacent segments.

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to $860M in total capital raised as a proxy for current value, applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical of Series D progression, yielding $1.3B. Peer-median valuation across 4 same-sector comparables—Sierra Space ($8.0B), Apex Space ($2.3B), Varda Space Industries ($1.6B), and Skyryse ($1.1B)—produces a median of $1.9B, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comparable anchoring is not applicable; while the Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 27.4x price-to-sales across 6 public tickers, Stoke Space's revenue is not on file.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.1B (low) to $2.2B (high), with a median of $1.6B. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory and near-term path to profitability relative to peer benchmarks, which explain the wide dispersion in the comparable set.
